offerings.title: Weekly Coherence Call
offerings.blurb: Live every Thursday. Come with your bottleneck, leave with one clear next step.
offerings.why: The simplest doorway in — free, live, and real.
offerings.creator: Sunheart

offerings.title: A Session with Sunheart
offerings.blurb: One conversation that maps where you are and what wants to move next.
offerings.why: Direct, personal, and honest — closer to a reading than a coaching call.
offerings.creator: Sunheart

offerings.title: The Coherence Course
offerings.blurb: A structured path through the seven areas of life: body, mind, relationships, work, money, purpose, environment.
offerings.why: For when the diagnostic shows you where to begin and you want a real path through.
offerings.creator: Sunheart

offerings.title: Zen Village Immersion · Costa Rica
offerings.blurb: A real-world gathering at Camp Zen — nervous-system repair, conscious community, and presence in the jungle.
offerings.why: The physical home of everything Full Potential points toward.
offerings.creator: Zen Village

offerings.title: Why We Sleep
offerings.blurb: Understand what sleep actually does for your body and mind, so you stop fighting it.
offerings.why: We selected this because once you grasp the science, better sleep stops feeling like a chore and starts feeling like a gift you give yourself.
offerings.creator: Matthew Walker

offerings.title: Yoga Nidra Practice
offerings.blurb: A guided body-scan rest that drops you into deep stillness without needing to fall asleep.
offerings.why: We love that this asks nothing of you but to lie down and listen — the simplest doorway back to rest.

offerings.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
offerings.blurb: See the hidden machinery behind your own choices and judge a little more clearly.
offerings.why: We recommend this because knowing how your mind fools itself is the first real step toward thinking well.
offerings.creator: Daniel Kahneman

offerings.title: Atomic Habits
offerings.blurb: Tiny, repeatable changes that quietly compound into a different life.
offerings.why: We chose this because it makes growth feel doable on the days you don't feel like growing at all.
offerings.creator: James Clear

offerings.title: Starting Strength
offerings.blurb: Learn the few barbell lifts that build a genuinely strong, capable body.
offerings.why: We picked this because it teaches sound fundamentals over hype — strength you can actually keep.
offerings.creator: Mark Rippetoe

offerings.title: Breath
offerings.blurb: Rediscover how you breathe and unlock energy you didn't know you were losing.
offerings.why: We selected this because the most powerful tool for vitality is the one you already carry everywhere.
offerings.creator: James Nestor

offerings.title: The Art of Gathering
offerings.blurb: Host moments that actually bring people closer instead of just filling a room.
offerings.why: We recommend this because real community is built one intentional gathering at a time.
offerings.creator: Priya Parker

offerings.title: Circling Practice Circle
offerings.blurb: A live, in-the-moment relational practice for being truly seen by others.
offerings.why: We love this because connection deepens fastest when people slow down and tell the truth together.

offerings.title: The Psychology of Money
offerings.blurb: Make peace with money by understanding the feelings that really drive it.
offerings.why: We chose this because lasting wealth starts with your behavior, not a hot tip.
offerings.creator: Morgan Housel

offerings.title: I Will Teach You to Be Rich
offerings.blurb: A practical system for automating your money so it grows while you live your life.
offerings.why: We selected this because it's honest, judgment-free, and built for normal people, not finance bros.
offerings.creator: Ramit Sethi

offerings.title: The Untethered Soul
offerings.blurb: Loosen the grip of the voice in your head and find the quiet underneath.
offerings.why: We recommend this because it points you home gently, without asking you to believe anything.
offerings.creator: Michael A. Singer

offerings.title: 10% Happier Meditation
offerings.blurb: Learn to meditate from teachers who skip the woo and keep it real.
offerings.why: We picked this for the skeptics — proof that stillness is for everyone, not just monks.
offerings.creator: Dan Harris

offerings.title: How Not to Die
offerings.blurb: See clearly which everyday foods protect you and which quietly wear you down.
offerings.why: We selected this because it hands you the evidence and lets you decide for yourself.
offerings.creator: Michael Greger

offerings.title: Salt, Fat, Acid, Heat
offerings.blurb: Cook with confidence by learning the four things that make any food taste good.
offerings.why: We love this because nourishing yourself becomes joyful once you understand how flavor works.
offerings.creator: Samin Nosrat

offerings.title: The Artist's Way
offerings.blurb: A 12-week path to clear the blocks and let your creativity flow again.
offerings.why: We recommend this because so many people aren't uncreative — they're just stuck, and this gently unsticks them.
offerings.creator: Julia Cameron

offerings.title: Big Magic
offerings.blurb: Make things for the love of it and let fear ride along without driving.
offerings.why: We chose this because it gives you permission to create without waiting to feel ready.
offerings.creator: Elizabeth Gilbert

offerings.title: Man's Search for Meaning
offerings.blurb: Find purpose by understanding that meaning is something you give, not get.
offerings.why: We selected this because the deepest service begins with knowing why your life matters.
offerings.creator: Viktor E. Frankl

offerings.title: The Boy, the Mole, the Fox and the Horse
offerings.blurb: A tender illustrated reminder that kindness is the bravest thing we do.
offerings.why: We love this because sometimes the way you grow is simply by being gentle with others and yourself.
offerings.creator: Charlie Mackesy

offerings.title: Insight Timer
offerings.blurb: A free library of guided meditations and sleep tracks from teachers worldwide.
offerings.why: We include this because the best meditation tool is the one that's free and always in your pocket.

offerings.title: Standing Desk Converter
offerings.blurb: Move between sitting and standing through the day to keep your body awake.
offerings.why: We recommend this for desk-bound people because small posture shifts add up to a healthier back.
